Ersagun's idea: go to another space, act, come back, as in a Rubik's cube commutator. Conjugation, f⁻¹ ∘ g ∘ f, is standard group theory.
Textbook: the 2.2 power is the simple form of the sRGB transfer curve (IEC 61966-2-1); doubling light in linear light, not in stored values, is standard colour practice.
Prior art: the band split is the Haar wavelet (Alfréd Haar, 1910); a multiband compressor splits with a crossover filter instead.
